pc: # Format: tab-separated, # = comment, blank lines OK.
#   pair_status   — PAIR (bit-exact value match) | PAIR_DRIFT (values match, cadence drifts ≤2) | FAIL_COUNT (values match, count differs) | FAIL_VALUES
#   plate_comment — multi-line description; "\n" → newline. Function plates only.
#   pre_comment   — single-line annotation at the exact pc. "" if blank.
# All entries derived from probe BP comments and AUDIO_PARITY_FINAL_STATE.md.
# === Layer 5: SPU register writers (the boundary FFT writes through to hit the SPU) ===

name: spu_kon_koff_dispatcher
plate_comment:
SPU KON/KOFF mask dispatcher.
Invoked by silent-driver and per-channel commit paths to stage KON/KOFF bits.
Writes do NOT go directly to SPU registers — they update RAM globals DAT_80037080-86 which are flushed to SPU SPU_KON_LO/HI / SPU_KOFF_LO/HI at IRQ time.
Args: a0 = voice-bit mask, a1 = mode (1 = KON, 0 = KOFF).
Probe: probe_kon_koff_mask. PCSX emits one bundled mask per dispatch; Godot's _commit_kon splits into per-voice calls, hence count divergence (FAIL on count, PAIR on values per-voice).
pre_comment: BP @ probe_kon_koff_mask: captures (mask, mode).

name: spu_write_voice_vol
plate_comment:
SPU voice volume L/R writer (no-sweep mode).
Writes SPU+0x00 (vol_L) and SPU+0x02 (vol_R) for the addressed voice.
Args: a0 = voice index (0..23), a1 = vol_L (i16), a2 = vol_R (i16).
Probe: probe_vol_register. PAIR 122/122 confirmed bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_vol_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_vol_sweep
plate_comment:
SPU voice volume L/R writer (sweep mode).
Sets the high-bit-on (sweep-mode) variant of vol_L/vol_R. Sweep mode bits encode rate/direction; see VolumeFlags in vendor/pcsx-redux/src/spu/interface.h.
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = vol_L u16, a2 = vol_R u16, a3 = mode bits.
Probe: probe_vol_register_sweep. PAIR 4/4 confirmed bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_vol_register_sweep entry.

name: spu_write_voice_pitch
plate_comment:
SPU voice pitch register writer.
The simplest SPU register write — one u16, no sweep, no RMW.
Body:
  addiu sp,sp,-0x8
  lui v0,0x8003; lw v0,-0x52bc(v0)  ; v0 = SPU IO base 0x1F801C00
  sll a0,a0,0x4 ; a0 = voice * 0x10
  addu a0,a0,v0
  sh a1,0x4(a0)                     ; SPU+0x4 = pitch
Args: a0 = voice (0..23), a1 = pitch u16.
Probe: probe_pitch_register. PAIR 222/222 confirmed bit-exact (1-cadence drift on 220/222 rows, value-exact).
pre_comment: BP @ probe_pitch_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_sample_start_addr
plate_comment:
SPU voice sample start_addr writer.
Writes SPU+0x06 with the ADPCM start address (in 8-byte units stored as byte offset). Used at instrument load / KON to seed pCurr.
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = start_addr.
Probe: probe_sample_start_addr_register. PAIR 4/4 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_sample_start_addr_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_sample_repeat_addr
plate_comment:
SPU voice sample repeat_addr (loop) writer.
Writes SPU+0x0E. The repeat address may point into a DIFFERENT instrument's ADPCM region (FFT loops sustained tones into shared cross-instrument data).
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = repeat_addr.
Probe: probe_sample_repeat_addr_register. PAIR 4/4 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_sample_repeat_addr_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_adsr1_mid
plate_comment:
SPU voice ADSR1 mid-nibble RMW writer.
Read-modify-write of SPU+0x08 bits 4-7 (decay rate nibble) + 0-3 (sustain level nibble). Mirrors PCSX-Redux SPU ADSR set via writeRegister.
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = decay_rate_nibble, a2 = sustain_level_nibble.
Probe: probe_adsr1_mid_register. PAIR 4/4 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_adsr1_mid_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_adsr1_low
plate_comment:
SPU voice ADSR1 low-nibble RMW writer.
Writes only the sustain level nibble (SPU+0x08 bits 0-3).
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = sustain_level u8 (0..15).
Probe: probe_adsr1_low_register. PAIR 4/4 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_adsr1_low_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_adsr1_high
plate_comment:
SPU voice ADSR1 high writer.
Writes SPU+0x08 bits 8-15: attack rate (bits 8-14) + attack mode (bit 15 0=linear/1=exponential).
Args: a0 = voice, a1 = attack_rate, a2 = attack_mode_exp.
Probe: probe_adsr1_high_register. PAIR 4/4 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_adsr1_high_register entry.

name: spu_write_voice_adsr2
plate_comment:
SPU voice ADSR2 high-bits writer.
Writes SPU+0x0A bits 6-15: sustain rate (bits 8-14) + sustain mode (bit 15) + sustain direction (bit 14) + sustain step (bits 6-7).
Probe BP: probe_adsr2_register @ 0x8001BA54 (the actual sh inside this function).
Probe: probe_adsr2_register. PAIR 11/11 bit-exact.

name: spu_write_voice_adsr2_low
plate_comment:
SPU voice ADSR2 low-bits writer.
Writes SPU+0x0A bits 0-5: release rate (bits 0-4) + release mode (bit 5).
Probe BP: probe_adsr2_low_register @ 0x8001BAF8 (the actual sh inside this function).
Probe: probe_adsr2_low_register. Values bit-exact; row count differs by 2 (init-seed asymmetry between PCSX and Godot).

name: adsr2_sh_site
plate_comment: (blank — labels don't get plates)
pre_comment: sh a1,0xa(a0)  ; SPU+0xA = ADSR2 high bits — probe_adsr2_register fires here.

name: adsr2_low_sh_site
pre_comment: sh a1,0xa(a0)  ; SPU+0xA = ADSR2 low bits — probe_adsr2_low_register fires here. Count drift = init-seed asymmetry only.

name: rcnt2_cadence_source
plate_comment: Cadence source (RCNT2 240 Hz IRQ entry / per-pulse handler).\nDrives the entire effect-sound timeline: each pulse advances dispatchers and walkers FLUSH_PER_DISPATCH=8 sub-ticks.\nProbe: probe_cadence_source. PAIR 1680/1680 bit-exact.
pre_comment: BP @ probe_cadence_source entry.

name: fft_walker_per_channel
plate_comment: Per-channel walker entry.\nIterates each channel's slot+0x64 voice mask and dispatches WALKER_FLAG_* fan-outs to SPU register writers (pitch/vol/adsr1/adsr2/sample addrs).\nProbe: probe_fun80017118_entry. PAIR 207/207 rows post-drift (≤3 cadence drift).
pre_comment: BP @ probe_fun80017118_entry.

name: walker_iter_body
pre_comment: Inner per-iter step inside fft_walker_per_channel. BP @ probe_fun80017118_iter (1656 hits).

name: walker_chan_clear
pre_comment: Per-channel state clear inside fft_walker_per_channel. BP @ probe_fun80017118_clear. 1-row value diff observed — minor walker-tail divergence, low audio impact.

name: walker_flag_word_entry
pre_comment: walker_flag_word read site at the top of the per-channel walker pass. BP @ probe_walker_flag_word_entry — 318/320 rows drift ≤±1 cad.

name: per_entity_iter_site
pre_comment: Per-entity iteration site (audible pair walking). probe_per_entity_iter PAIR 5037 vs 5040 (≤±3 entity-budget drift). Also probe_entity_dump BP.

name: per_entity_pass_site
pre_comment: Per-entity pass site — probe_per_entity_pass PAIR 519/519.

name: spu_slot_loop_site
pre_comment: SPU slot loop inside per-entity pass. probe_spu_slot_loop PAIR 207/207.

name: per_channel_tick_entry_site
pre_comment: Per-channel tick handler entry. probe_per_channel_tick_entry PAIR 1656/1656. NB: this PC also CLEARS chan+0x88 (pitch_bend) on each tick — see PC 0x800151BC for the clear instruction.

name: per_channel_tick_exit_site
pre_comment: Per-channel tick handler exit / unpaired probe diagnostic.

name: portamento_a2_wrap_site
pre_comment: Portamento target_counter (a2) wrap probe site. probe_porta_a2_wrap.

name: expression_ramp_site
pre_comment: Expression / volume ramp staging site. probe_expression_ramp PAIR 70/70.

name: portamento_a4_wrap_site
pre_comment: Portamento accumulator (a4) wrap probe site. probe_porta_a4_wrap.

name: event_dispatch_site
pre_comment: Per-event dispatch site (opcode jumptable arrival). probe_event_dispatch PAIR 165/165.

name: note_handler_site
pre_comment: Note opcode handler body. probe_note_handler PAIR 78/78.

name: note_post_state_site
pre_comment: Post-Note staged state snapshot. probe_note_post_state PAIR 78/78.

pre_comment: Pre-state for slur propagation (pcsx=81 godot=79 — 2-row count delta, value-paired). probe_slur_propagation_pre.

name: slur_propagation_site
pre_comment: Slur-flag propagation effect. probe_slur_propagation PAIR 78/78.

name: vol_prestage_lfo_site
pre_comment: Per-tick CHAN1_VOL_PRESTAGE set gate (LFO mode 1 active = chan+0xfe==3). probe_vol_prestage_lfo PAIR 1/1.

name: smd_op_rest
plate_comment: 0x80 Rest opcode.\nProbe: probe_opcode_rest PAIR 1/1.\nSee MUSIC_ITER58 — post-Rest lookahead drives the end-of-note ADSR2-LOW=6 gate.

name: smd_op_end_bar
plate_comment: 0x90 EndBar / barline opcode.\nProbe: probe_opcode_endbar PAIR 2/2.

name: smd_op_octave
plate_comment: 0x94 Octave shift opcode (absolute set).\nProbe: probe_opcode_octave PAIR 4/4.

name: smd_op_lower_octave
plate_comment: 0x96 Lower-octave opcode (octave -1). Jumptable 0x80028B64. NB: pre-fix HIGH described this as opcode 0x97 — jumptable proves 0x96.\nProbe: probe_opcode_lower_octave PAIR 7/7.

name: smd_op_repeat
plate_comment: 0x98 Repeat opcode.\nProbe: probe_opcode_repeat PAIR 3/3.

name: smd_op_coda
plate_comment: 0x99 Coda opcode.\nProbe: probe_opcode_coda PAIR 21/21.

name: smd_op_instrument_set
plate_comment: 0xAC Instrument-select opcode. Jumptable 0x80028BBC.\nResolves inst from WAVESET via FFT's +1 indexing rule: runtime inst N → WAVESET inst (N+1). Stores to chan+0x30+inst*16+0x30; populates the audible voice's fine_tune + ADSR registers for the next KON. AC writes per-channel state always — audible voice updates slot.* immediately.\nProbe: probe_opcode_instrument PAIR 4/4.

name: smd_op_slur_on
plate_comment: 0xB0 Slur-on opcode (sets channel.flag_word bit 0x800). Jumptable 0x80028BCC.\nCurrent Ghidra name "smd_flag_0x800" reflected the bit being set; semantic is "slur on".\nProbe: probe_opcode_slur_on PAIR 3/3.

name: smd_op_reverb_on
plate_comment: 0xBA Reverb-on opcode. Jumptable 0x80028BF4. NB: pre-fix HIGH described this as opcode 0xC0 — jumptable proves 0xBA.\nWrites pool+0x70 |= chan+0x34 (per-voice reverb-enable mask, FFT manages reverb in RAM, NOT via SPU reverb-enable registers) AND slot+0x4 |= 0x40 (WALKER_FLAG_ADSR2_HIGH).\nProbe: probe_opcode_reverb_on PAIR 2/2.

name: smd_op_c4_adsr2_sustain
plate_comment: 0xC4 ADSR2 Sustain Bits modifier. Jumptable 0x80028C1C. NB: pre-fix Ghidra called this smd_release/opcode 0xC8; an earlier labels rev mis-tagged it 0xCA. Jumptable proves 0xC4.\nDisasm: lhu v0,0x4(a2); ori v0,v0,0x40; sh v0,0x4(a2); sh v1,0x68(a2). Walker fans out via spu_write_voice_adsr2_high (FUN_8001b9d4) with mode a3 from slot+0x58 (==1→0; ==5→0x200; ==7→0x300; else 0x100).\nProbe: probe_opcode_adsr2_sustain PAIR 9/9.

name: smd_op_d0_pitch_bend_init
plate_comment: 0xD0 PitchBend initial.\nSets channel.pitch_bend to the param.\nProbe: probe_opcode_d0_pitch_bend PAIR 1/1.

name: smd_op_d1_pitch_bend_relative
plate_comment: 0xD1 PitchBend relative.\nAccumulates: channel.pitch_bend += param.\nProbe: probe_opcode_d1_pitch_bend PAIR 21/21.

name: smd_op_d4_portamento_init_body
pre_comment: Body of 0xD4 PortamentoInit. pre_pitch_delta_u32 = (s8 rate << 24) / target. probe_opcode_d4_portamento PAIR 1/1. (Function entry is just before this PC; rename containing function to smd_op_d4_portamento_init.)

name: smd_op_d8_pitch_lfo_init
plate_comment: 0xD8 PitchLFO_Init (FUN_80016420 / jumptable 0x80028C6C).\nSets channel.lfo_step_base = rate^2 << 14 (UNDIVIDED per cure savestate observation); channel.lfo_period_reload = param[0]; chan+0xFE = 3 (mode 1). Mode 1 = alternating swap callback @ LAB_80017690.\nNot directly probed but referenced by probe_lfo_swap / probe_vol_prestage_lfo.

name: smd_op_d9_lfo
plate_comment:
0xD9 LFO (FUN_800164D4 / jumptable 0x80028C70).
Differences from 0xD8:
  - rate sign IS preserved: lo = -rate² for rate<0 (vs 0xD8 always +rate²)
  - param[2] is bit-decoded: bit 0x10 = mode flag (chan+0xFE = 1 vs 3); low 0x0F = waveform_index → PTR_LAB_80028F54[wf_idx] for chan+0xE0
  - chan+0xF6 = 0, chan+0xFD = waveform_index
  - FUN_80016BF8 called with a2 = waveform_index
Probe: probe_opcode_d9_lfo PAIR 1/1.

name: smd_op_db_flag_clear_body
pre_comment: Body of 0xDB FlagClear. Clears bit 0x1 of chan+0xFE (disables LFO mode 1 sub-slot). probe_opcode_db_flag_clear PAIR 1/1.

name: smd_op_e0_dynamics
plate_comment: 0xE0 Dynamics opcode.\nWrites dynamics_byte = read8(a0) to channel state; overrides LFO mode 1 → mode 2 (LAB_800176E4, which bypasses probe_lfo_swap).\nProbe: probe_opcode_dynamics PAIR 4/4.

name: smd_op_e2_vol_scale
plate_comment: 0xE2 Expression / Volume-Scale opcode. Jumptable 0x80028C94.\nThe probe calls it vol_scale because it scales the audible-voice volume staging; HIGH keeps the historical name smd_expression.\nProbe: probe_opcode_e2_vol_scale PAIR 2/2.

pre_comment: Walker site where pre_pitch / pitch_bend / fine_tune are read and pitch_staging is committed. probe_pitch_inputs + probe_pitch_staging both fire here.

pc: # === Supporting functions referenced from probes / doc but not directly probed ===

name: async_commit_walker_irq
plate_comment:
Async-commit walker IRQ handler (called on every SPU IRQ pulse).
Drains slot+0x64 voice masks per channel and dispatches WALKER_FLAG_* fan-outs into the SPU register writers (spu_write_voice_*).
Doc reference: AUDIO_PARITY_FINAL_STATE.md §3 ("Final hardware register writes happen at IRQ-flush from RAM globals DAT_80037080-86 — NOT directly via FUN_8001ACF0").
Not directly probed; verified by downstream probes pairing.

name: spu_io_write_helper
plate_comment: SPU IO 16-bit write helper. Wraps `sh a1, offset(a0)` with the SPU base offset (0x1F801C00).\nCallers: spu_write_voice_sample_start_addr, spu_write_voice_sample_repeat_addr, and one early-return path at 0x8001AFE4.\nDoc reference: AUDIO_PARITY_FINAL_STATE.md §3.

pc: # === Pitch-LFO mode callbacks (slot+0x100 fn-ptr targets, called from walker) ===
# These are not in the manifest as function entries (Ghidra has them as LAB_)
# but they ARE callable functions. The applicator script creates them.

name: pitch_lfo_callback_mode1_swap
plate_comment: Pitch-LFO mode-1 callback: alternating swap.\nInstalled by smd_op_d8_pitch_lfo_init and (with chan+0xFE=3) smd_op_d9_lfo. Per IRQ pulse: decrement chan+0xF4 countdown; on 0 → swap step sign and store to chan+0x88 (pitch_bend).\nInner sw a1,0x4(a0) at 0x800176CC is the probe site (probe_lfo_swap, PAIR 36/36).

name: pitch_lfo_callback_mode2
plate_comment: Pitch-LFO mode-2 callback.\nInstalled by smd_op_e0_dynamics override (chan+0xFE = 1 from mode-2 D9 path also). Bypasses the swap at 0x800176CC — probe_lfo_swap does NOT fire while this callback is active.

name: scus_item_record
plate_comment: Item record pointer helper: returns 0x80062EB8 + (id&0xff)*12 - the 12-byte common item record (rec[0] palette, rec[1] graphic, rec[3] slot_flags, rec[4] second_table_id, rec[5] item_type_id class byte, rec[8..9] price). Table = SCUS file 0x536B8 (extract_items.py ITEMS_OFFSET); byte-identical RAM/file/items.json. NOTE: undisassembled bytes in the scus export - disassembled by hand (mipsdis.py). [MD:ITEM_EQUIPMENT_DATA.md#1]

name: scus_item_stock_ledger
pre_comment: Per-item party stock count bytes (id-indexed, 0xFE entries), adjusted via world_item_stock_adjust 0x801208b8. [MD:ITEM_EQUIPMENT_DATA.md#3]

pre_comment: Runtime per-category item DISPLAY-ORDER lists (0xFF-terminated id bytes): +0 weapons+shields, 0x80057be8 head, 0x80057c08 body, 0x80057c30 accessory, 0x80057c54 chemist. Most-recent-acquired first; descending id after a full world_item_list_sync rebuild. Emptied by the new-game init 0x800455b0+. [MD:ITEM_EQUIPMENT_DATA.md#4]
